stories.title: D20 First Day of School — Preschool, Kindergarten, 6th, and 9th Grade Start Today
stories.angle: FOLLOW-UP + LIVE COVERAGE (2026-08-04 S4, 2026-08-16 S5 D20 previews) — Today is the first day of the 2026-27 school year for Academy District 20 preschool, kindergarten, 6th, and 9th grade students. D20 is the largest COS-area district by enrollment. Neighbor district D11 already started August 12; D49 already started August 4.

stories.title: CPSC Warning — Budget Baby Boost Crib Bumpers (Suffocation Hazard)
stories.angle: NEW STORY — August 6, 2026: CPSC warns consumers to stop using Budget Baby Boost Crib Bumpers immediately due to suffocation risk. The product violates the federal ban on crib bumpers established under the Safe Sleep for Babies Act. Approximately 141 units affected. CPSC guidance: stop use immediately, dispose (do NOT resell or give away). Timely for COS parents preparing for fall — many use hand-me-downs from older siblings or purchased on secondary markets.

stories.title: Target Recalls Gigglescape Under the Sea Popping Toy — 49,000 Units, Choking Hazard
stories.angle: NEW STORY — Target recalled 49,000 Gigglescape Under the Sea Popping Toys after nine reports of the clear plastic dome detaching, including one child who began to choke on the small plastic balls inside. Toy is a blue whale-shaped plunger toy sold at Target nationwide August 2025 through January 2026 for about $10. Recall number 26-598. Return to any Target store for full refund, or contact Target for a prepaid return label.

stories.title: Back-to-School Sleep Reset — What COS Pediatricians Recommend
stories.angle: NEW STORY (evergreen with local timing hook) — D20 opens today, D11 opened Aug 12, D49 opened Aug 4 — most COS families are one week or less into the school routine. Pediatric sleep guidance: kids need 9-12 hours (ages 6-12) and 8-10 hours (ages 13-18); shift bedtime by 15 minutes earlier each night for a week; blackout curtains help with COS's late summer sunsets; screens off 60 minutes before bed. Tips are AAP-backed and useful for the entire first week of school when routines are still resetting.

Back-to-School Sleep Reset
**HIGH confidence (AAP-backed general guidance):**
- Kids ages 6-12: 9-12 hours sleep per night
- Kids ages 13-18: 8-10 hours sleep per night
- Recommendation to shift bedtime 15 minutes earlier per night to reset
- Recommendation: screens off 60 minutes before bed
- Blackout curtains help offset late summer sunsets

- D49 first day: Aug 4 (13 days in)
